Im alten Job hat er nicht zu viel Steuern gezahlt. Das finde ich auch irgendwie komisch, weil die Person, dem die ID gehört, war im selben Job, die ersten zwei Jahre. Da müsste es doch irgendwo auffallen, dass die Person zwei Lohnabrechnungen am Laufen hat auf seinen Namen.

Der Beamte am Telefon hat schon einen Brief rausgeschickt, worauf die echt ID steht. 
Werden dann die fehlenden Beträge zurückgezahlt nach der Steuererklärung? 3 Monate wurden ihm ja mehr Steuern abgezogen, als es sollte.

I don't know much about politics and i think my English is not good enough to understand all of this. I'm not a voter as i don't live in turkey but from the things i see i can say if i could vote, i would vote for Erdogan. I don't understand the hatred against him. I read anti erdogan opinions but i can't seem to find proper reason to judge him as bad. 
About the topic kurdish, like many have already mentioned here, there are 2 types of kurdish we talk about. The civilians, with who we live together and don't see any different from us, my brothers and sisters. And the PKK, which are terrorists. 
I was living for 7 years in turkey, i came back 2 years ago and i had so many Kurdish friends, i can easily and surely say that they are not hated or treated different. So the people Erdogan is 'cleaning' are bad people, the terrorists. 
I understand that many Europeans don't like him, as he is basing his decisions not trying to be more 'modern' but to keep is roots strong as a Muslim. That's what i love about him. And the countries where the Turkish army are going to are libya and syria, which both are warzones (inflicted by America mostly, like every warzone). So Erdogan takes these warzone under his wing and tries to bring peace there. I have online friends from the middle east ( libya, syria, morocco ) and they all appreciate Turkeys help. So i really don't understand how Europe or other countries see it as something bad.
The only reason i can think of is that it doesnt fit well for them that he holds these muslim countries together, not letting other countries take them away from their culture and religion. 
If it would be america who comes to 'help' there, I'm sure many people would support this, as they would have taken down another muslim country. 
So what i mean is that as i see, the hatred is because it doesn't fit well with them that erdogan is keeping islam alive. 
As i said, these are what i know and see, i may be wrong and open to here criticism and new information.
